title: no sensitive content in photos; the uploader confirms, a report hides

criteria.text: No image of a child, animal or pet, or anyone who can't fend for themselves; the uploader confirms, nothing is pre-screened
criteria.note: `PagePhotoPicker` waits for the tick and clears it after every upload; Page photo, Page picture and post photo all use it; the tick is client-side as ruled (#483) [V]. Unclaimed-Page photos are staff-loaded under the stock-only rule, not a member upload (#810, #811, #887, #890, #976, #980) [V] Checked: `[guards F080.1]` in `PagePhotoPicker.test.tsx:179`: every member photo surface goes through the one picker and the upload path imports no classifier, seen failing against four mutants (#901, closed #835) [V] Reviewed: #483 `review-skipped` [V] Smoked: `page-edit` green 2026-10-23 (cb892a7); the editor loads, no upload is made [A]

criteria.text: Text is not in scope; only images are restricted

criteria.text: No toggle, setting, tier, request or workaround allows it
criteria.note: Standing guard that nothing lifts the photo rule (#781) [V] Checked: `[guards F080.3]` in `f080-guards.test.ts` [V] Reviewed: #781 no `Reviewed by:` [V]

criteria.text: A reported image is caught by F078: a sensitive-content flag hides at any bar and texts the operator
criteria.note: Sensitive content hides a Page picture or post photo past the limits and alerts the operator (#483); email through Resend until Twilio exists (#751, #707 open) [V] Checked: `[guards F080.4]` in `f078-criteria.test.ts:358`: hides on the first report at a 0.99 bar from a struck-out reporter, alerts by email without Twilio and by SMS with it, seen failing against three mutants (#901) [V] Reviewed: #483 `review-skipped` [V]

criteria.text: Wherever a member posts, the app asks not to post sensitive content, and why; each photo upload asks to confirm
